output.response_text:
Dear Enterprise Client 13,

Thank you for bringing the delay of your replacement parts order #ORD-8819 to our attention. I understand how important timely delivery is for your operations, and I apologize for any inconvenience this has caused.

We are actively investigating the situation and have taken the following steps:

- Verified the fulfillment status of order #ORD-8819 in our order management system.
- Retrieved the carrier’s tracking number and current shipment status.
- Contacted the carrier’s support desk to confirm whether there are any delays, loss, or address‑related holds.
- Reviewed the address verification log for the shipping destination. If a mismatch is identified, we will request your confirmation of the correct address.
- Checked our inventory records to ensure the replacement parts were in stock at the time of order. If an inventory issue contributed to the delay, we will prioritize a restock and arrange an expedited reship.
- Based on the carrier’s feedback, we will either arrange an expedited reship or file a claim for a lost package.
- You will receive a clear estimated time of arrival and next‑step details within the next 5 business days, in line with our high‑urgency SLA.
- Our account manager has been notified of the issue and the actions we are taking.

We will keep you updated throughout this process and will close the ticket once you confirm receipt of the parts.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Sincerely,
Customer Support Team
